entries.title: Psalms 81:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to the Gittith. Of Asaph.> Make a song to God our strength: make a glad cry to the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:2
segments: Take up the melody, playing on an instrument of music, even on corded instruments.

entries.title: Psalms 81:3
segments: Let the horn be sounded in the time of the new moon, at the full moon, on our holy feast-day:

entries.title: Psalms 81:4
segments: For this is a rule for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:5
segments: He gave it to Joseph as a witness, when he went out over the land of Egypt; then the words of a strange tongue were sounding in my ears.

entries.title: Psalms 81:6
segments: I took the weight from his back; his hands were made free from the baskets.

entries.title: Psalms 81:7
segments: You gave a cry in your trouble, and I made you free; I gave you an answer in the secret place of the thunder; I put you to the test at the waters of Meribah. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 81:8
segments: ¶Give ear, O my people, and I will give you my word, O Israel, if you will only do as I say!

entries.title: Psalms 81:9
segments: There is to be no strange god among you; you are not to give worship to any other god.

entries.title: Psalms 81:10
segments: I am the Lord your God, who took you up from the land of Egypt: let your mouth be open wide, so that I may give you food.

entries.title: Psalms 81:11
segments: But my people did not give ear to my voice; Israel would have nothing to do with me.

entries.title: Psalms 81:12
segments: So I gave them up to the desires of their hearts; that they might go after their evil purposes.

entries.title: Psalms 81:13
segments: If only my people would give ear to me, walking in my ways!

entries.title: Psalms 81:14
segments: I would quickly overcome their haters: my hand would be turned against those who make war on them.

entries.title: Psalms 81:15
segments: The haters of the Lord would be broken, and their destruction would be eternal.

entries.title: Psalms 81:16
segments: I would give them the best grain for food; you would be full of honey from the rock.
